generationRequest.prompt: Use case: edit reference background into ONE isolated transparent FAR ORGAN PARALLAX LAYER for a 2D side-scrolling underwater game inside a dead whale. Preserve reference matte painted gouache style and organ identity. Output landscape16:9 canvas, keep original 1672x941 aspect and composition anchors. This layer contains only 1 or 2 broad perimeter anatomical contours as a single layer, with a large completely transparent center and lower center for gameplay. REMOVE ALL blue water, water rays, bubbles, specks, haze, background wash, floor platforms, near framing, creatures and all props. All empty areas must have genuine zero-alpha transparency, no blue rectangle, no checker pattern. Keep far anatomy muted cool low contrast with soft internal shading but a clean external alpha edge. No bright top ledges that read as gameplay terrain, no cropped gameplay modules. Depict only the following far organ forms: Broad distant gastric folds along upper RIGHT and LEFT lower side perimeter, muted ochre and olive-brown with coolblue shadow. Solid soft stomach folds, no bone, teeth, baleen, acid pool or water surface. Keep the entire center and bottom-middle open transparent; no continuous floor lip. Avoid small hanging mucus strands and bright ledges; just the far organ wall contours. Do not retain water or light rays.
